recipes.name: youtube-comment
recipes.description: Reach a YouTube video's comment box and fill it with $TEXT. Vision-first (find the 'Add a comment' placeholder), keystroke type with clipboard-paste fallback. STOPS before posting: the final Comment-button click only runs with --confirm.

steps.note: scroll down toward the comments section
vision-first; place cursor in the compose box
keystroke, with paste fallback on empty result
SUBMIT — only fires with --confirm; otherwise the box is left filled, unposted

recipes.name: x-compose
recipes.description: Focus X (Twitter) and fill the compose box with $TEXT. Vision-first find of the 'What is happening' placeholder. STOPS before posting: the Post button click only runs with --confirm.
